plugin.name: RehearsalPlayer
plugin.title: Rehearsal Player
plugin.desc: Dark, playlist-driven rehearsal playback with tutor/class filters, artwork playlist selection, large transport controls, quick jump presets, and a Spotify-backed teacher playlist section.
plugin.changes: Fixed a bug from 1.1.10 where shrinking track tiles for a short playlist left a dead click zone around each button - tiles now only get shorter (never centered/shrunk in place), so every visible pixel of a tile stays clickable.
plugin.creator: Jazzart
